sentences.text:
-----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
-----
 For the Petitioners : Mr. Praveen Shankar Dayal, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Shashi Kumar Verma, A.P.P.
 -----
02/16.05.2024

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for
 the State.

2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Gola P.S. Case No.72/2023,
registered for the alleged offence under Sections 376, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in
the Court of the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ramgarh.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the informant is a major lady and she was married and after death of her husband, she has come into relationship with Angat Karmali and so far as these petitioners are concerned, they have been falsely implicated in the case they were objecting the marriage of the informant with Angat Karmali and subsequently Angat Karmali has also refused for marriage.
4.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer on the ground that the allegations of Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code is there.

5. Considering that the informant is a lady and she has come into relationship with Angat Karmali and these petitioners had objected the marriage and it appears that the relationship was established several times, which was consensual in nature and in the attending facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

sentences.text: 6. Accordingly, the above-named petitioners are directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrender, they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1 st Class, Ramgarh in connection with Gola P.S. Case No.72/2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Ajay/
